params.body:
The desk listed every draft of every editor. A draft is half-thought work, and it is nobody else's business until its author sends it to review.

**The rule** (`visibleTo` in `articles-store.mjs`, applied in the list query and on every route under `/articles/:id`)
- A draft with an author is visible to that author only.
- A draft without an author (the imported pieces) stays shared.
- Anything in review or published is the team's.

**What another editor sees**
- The desk list and its total leave the other editor's drafts out.
- `/articles/:id` and every route under it answer 404, for reading and for writing: chat, evidence, draft-full, delete.
- The review page and its submit run on their own signed link, so they keep working for the reviewer it was sent to.
- The static API token is a machine, not an editor, so nothing is restricted for it. The projection and imports are not affected.

On production today: 11 drafts carry an author, 15 imported drafts have none, and 63 posts are published.

Tests: `test/private-drafts.test.mjs`, 4 cases (desk, no viewer, list route, 404 on read, chat and delete). Full suite 961 passing.
params.title: Studio: a draft is its author's
